name: indexer-calibration-v0
purpose: Diagnose known zero-score failures on development data. Not a fresh efficacy test or official training reproduction.
scope: Same 24 train and 8 development paragraphs from prior runs. Do not load or score the test split. Only RMS gains and positive score scale differ; dimensions, initialization, RoPE and data order held constant.
decision_rule: Inspect development all-zero-query rate and nonzero training gradients together with dense-target KL and attention output error. No hyperparameter sweep or selected-seed claim. Calibration improvement is an implementation finding, not a novel sparse-training method.
